The '''Nek Pup armored gun platform''' was a mobile platform used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The Nek Pup armored gun platform was equipped with a [[repeater blaster rifle]].

==History==
Several Nek Pup platforms were put into use by members of the [[14th Infantry Brigade|14th]] and [[85th Infantry Brigade]]s on [[Haurgab]], where they were used to provide cover for [[Omega Squad]], and put down pockets of resistance.

==Appearances==
*''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''
